speaker: Doctor
text: I'm sorry to hear your baby is unwell; can you tell me exactly when the vomiting started and if it has been green or yellow in color? Additionally, have they passed any stool since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-day-old male infant. The infant was born via a home birth without complications. The mother reports that the infant has had bilious vomiting and has not been able to pass meconium since birth. She also notes that the infant's abdomen appears distended.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Malrotation with Volvulus (highly suspected given bilious vomiting in a newborn who has not passed meconium). I urgently need an abdominal X-ray and an upper GI series to confirm this immediately.
